_basis: Ocean's estimates over the measured clusters of CENSUS_BATCH9 (run cda8882d). expected_recoverable = conservative-optimistic (mid). score = mid / effort_sessions / cost_factor; cost_factor 1.0 = native text, deterministic; 1.1 = depends on the cached local-Tesseract text (CPU only, $0 vendor); gated rows score 0 until their ruling lands. Yields for batch-8 census families start from the census's own pro-rated expectation (census yield on remaining) and the verify columns where they exist; the rest are judgement from the run's deterministic signatures (coverage, breaks, codes, density). Nothing here is a measurement.

CP-DECLINES.root_cause: core-processor template readers recognise the document (exclusive marker, score 1.0) and fail closed in parse: layout variants on native text (17) and OCR noise on Tesseract text (21); folders all Unidentified
CP-DECLINES.likely_fix: widen the four readers' row/summary grammars on the native variants first, then OCR-tolerant tokens for the scanned members (CP-SECTIONED-SCAN precedent); one decline-reason probe per reader before any change
CP-DECLINES.regression_surface: every core_processor_* / category_partition validated family (mutation tables + family replays mandatory)
CP-DECLINES.marginal_cost: $0 vendor; native text + cached Tesseract; CPU only

DECL:huntington.root_cause: one institution, one reader: huntington claims at detection (required markers only, score 0.5) and parse returns None on 12 native documents of 3-10 pages - a layout variant the reader's grammar does not cover
DECL:huntington.likely_fix: probe the 12 declines for the shared missing shape; widen huntington's period/summary/row grammar; family replay over the validated huntington cohort

RV-PAGE-COVERAGE.root_cause: integrity flag missing_declared_statement_page with reconciliation OK on all 11: the declared page count and the delivered pages disagree - either a genuinely partial upload (stays review, fail closed) or a misread declaration
RV-PAGE-COVERAGE.likely_fix: read-only probe first: declared count vs page_count per sha; fix only a proven misread of the declaration; never relax the page-coverage check
RV-PAGE-COVERAGE.regression_surface: page-coverage integrity check (shared); linkbank / community_section / southside / citizens / texas_first readers

FAM-PNC-LAYOUTS.root_cause: three PNC product layouts the pnc reader's markers do not claim (census conf 0.7-0.8, oracle present); with WH:pnc (4, coverage 0-0.24 = rows not captured) and DECL:pnc (1) PNC is a 17-document institution
FAM-PNC-LAYOUTS.likely_fix: widen the pnc reader (markers + row grammar) to the three layouts; measure with the pnc family replay; take WH:pnc row capture in the same session if the grammar is shared

WH-ROW-CAPTURE.root_cause: withheld with an extraction signature in the run's own payload: rbc credit coverage 0.46-0.86 with 5-14 continuity breaks (rows missed), pnc coverage 0-0.24 (rows not captured), bmo coverage 1.7 (rows duplicated), scotiabank/wells breaks 2-8 - the ledger cannot close because the reader's row set is wrong, not because evidence is absent
WH-ROW-CAPTURE.likely_fix: per-reader row-grammar fixes measured by coverage -> 1.0 and breaks -> 0 on the withheld members, family replay on the validated members; rbc/bmo/scotiabank are CAD-pinned surfaces (currency doctrine)
WH-ROW-CAPTURE.confidence: medium-high (signatures are measured; fixes are per reader)
WH-ROW-CAPTURE.regression_surface: rbc / pnc / bmo / wells_fargo / scotiabank / ibc validated cohorts; PINNED_CURRENCY surface for the Canadian readers

DECL:community_section.root_cause: community_section (the sectioned core family) claims and declines 9 native documents (Rogue CU 3, Chase-folder 2, Unidentified 4) - a section-grammar variant
DECL:community_section.likely_fix: decline-reason probe; widen the section grammar; replay the 62-document validated community_section cohort
DECL:community_section.regression_surface: community_section validated cohort (largest sectioned family) + WITHHELD-GRIDS leaf behaviour

CAPITAL-ONE.root_cause: one institution across three groups: capital_one declines 6 native six-page documents, the capital_one_360 layout (6, census conf 0.35) is unclaimed, 1 withheld (A+B+D)

WH-CLOSE-FULL-COVERAGE.root_cause: withheld with detail coverage ~1.0 and 0 breaks but the closing/period checks fail (codes A, A+C, A+D, C): summary identity or period edges disagree with a ledger that is internally consistent - printed daily-balance grids or closing labels the reader does not consume (batch-8 withheld census headline), or out-of-period rows (D)
WH-CLOSE-FULL-COVERAGE.likely_fix: per-reader: consume the printed grid / closing label (WITHHELD-GRIDS precedent), period-edge handling for D; measured by the ADB check set on the withheld members
WH-CLOSE-FULL-COVERAGE.regression_surface: southside_scanned / citizens / td_us / eq_bank_scanned / relay / zions / regions cohorts; ADB doctrine (calendar-day period) untouched

SCAN-UNCLAIMED.root_cause: 89 scanned/mixed documents with Tesseract text no reader claims. Measured split: dense 25 (15 with 2+ pages; hints TD 12, Wells 6, Chase 5, BoA 4 across the block), medium 13, thin 51 (42 single-page, <600 chars or <3 money tokens per page - screenshots, photos, partial pages). Only the dense members are a reader problem; the thin members are a classification problem
SCAN-UNCLAIMED.likely_fix: dense: OCR-tolerant markers/grammar on the existing td_us / wells_fargo / chase / bank_of_america readers (scanned variants), measured on the cached text; thin/medium: no deterministic path - they are the population for a later, measured VLM experiment, not wave 1
SCAN-UNCLAIMED.expected_recoverable: 5-12 (8) from the dense 25; 0 from the thin/medium 64 in this wave
SCAN-UNCLAIMED.regression_surface: td_us / wells_fargo / chase / bank_of_america scanned cohorts; OCR-stage version

DECL-OTHER-READERS.root_cause: 22 readers each declining 1-6 documents (45 total); bmo_ca_business's 6 are single-page (summary pages, low); columbia_bank / core-daily / texas_first / eq_bank / apex / first_farmers decline on Tesseract text; the rest are native grammar gaps of 1-3 documents each
DECL-OTHER-READERS.likely_fix: per-reader decline probes bundled by institution; take a reader only when its probe shows a shared shape; WELCH x DESC-COLUMNS (361167E3) is the carded WELCH-PRINTED-ROWS case

FAM-CU-SUFFIX-CORE.root_cause: the largest deterministic reservoir: 37 credit-union families / 176 documents (census yield 95.0) sharing core-processor mechanics - suffix sections, summary-of-accounts roll-ups, equation summaries, dot leaders - with the L-1 multi-account exposure the batch-8 verify flagged (cu_summary_of_accounts: 3 not 7 under the current architecture; Space Coast in the open L-1 ruling)
FAM-CU-SUFFIX-CORE.likely_fix: NOT per-family readers. One shared suffix/summary template family (as core_processor_* is for banks) with per-family markers, built AFTER the L-1 multi-account ruling; until then only single-suffix members are publishable and their share is unmeasured
FAM-CU-SUFFIX-CORE.confidence: low until L-1 is ruled; medium after
FAM-CU-SUFFIX-CORE.regression_surface: new template family - no existing cohort, but the ADB doctrine and the L-1 rule are load-bearing
FAM-CU-SUFFIX-CORE.gate: L-1 multi-account ruling (open) - scored 0 until then; unscored value 6.3

TEXT-LAYER-DEFECT.root_cause: 8 digital documents whose embedded fonts decode to a substitution alphabet (digits included); RBC x4 with an existing reader. The census's vowel-share proxy does NOT separate them (0.68-1.0) - a detector is still missing
TEXT-LAYER-DEFECT.likely_fix: the first 'cheap OCR' rung: rasterise + local Tesseract for digital documents that are unclaimed AND carry a bank hint, triggered deterministically; provenance recorded; measured on these 8 before widening
TEXT-LAYER-DEFECT.regression_surface: OCR ladder / OCR_STAGE_VERSION; must not touch documents with a sound text layer
TEXT-LAYER-DEFECT.marginal_cost: $0 vendor; Tesseract CPU per triggered document

FAM-BANK-TAIL-REST.root_cause: 29 families / 83 documents of 1-11 each (census yield 50.0): per-family readers at ~1 session for 1-4 documents; american_savings_bank_hawaii (11, verify LOW, filed under Chase - a folder/identity contradiction) and the 3 core_enclosures residual (scrambled text layers) are the low end; ATB consolidated (4) is ceremony-gated
